environment.description: Container running on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (forward all to target group). Security group allows inbound TCP/8080 from ALB only. No additional request inspection layers. Container runs as non-root user with read-only root filesystem except /tmp. Environment variables: FLASK_DEBUG=0. The service is exposed via ALB DNS at inventory-api.internal.corp.net on port 443 with TLS termination at ALB.

config.load_balancer: ALB with default forwarding rule, no WAF attached
config.network: Private subnet, ALB in public subnet
